## About me

Hi! I am Zana, a second-year PhD student at Karolinska Institutet. As you can see I love pasta. I spend most of my free time dancing, running, and beeing outdoors. 

## My research

My PhD project is about **immune evasion in Merkel cell carcinoma**, a rare and aggressive skin cancer. I am trying to understand why some tumours do not respond to immunotherapy. 


## Why this blog?

I started this blog during the course *Reproducible Research in Bioinformatics and Computational Biology* (September 2026). I use it as a report of what we did during the course, and a notebook I can come back to whenever I need to remember how to use the tools we learned.
